description: Pan-India emergency number. Call or send an SMS for immediate danger, flood rescue, electrical hazards, road incidents, fire, police, or medical help.
Relief Commissioner disaster helpline listed by the Government of India. For immediate rescue, call 112.
Government of India road accident helpline. Call 112 as well when someone needs urgent police, ambulance, or rescue assistance.
National ambulance helpline listed by the Government of India. Use 112 for an integrated emergency response.

category: Road damage, drainage, flooding, garbage, street lights
description: Contact your city or district municipal control room for non-life-threatening civic repairs. Call 112 if there is immediate danger or a rescue is needed.
Use your electricity bill or state distribution company website for the local fault number. Keep away from fallen wires and call 112 for immediate danger.
Legacy police emergency number. The Government of India ERSS provides the unified emergency number 112.
Legacy fire and rescue number. The Government of India ERSS provides the unified emergency number 112.
